description: An ambulatory services administrator must authorize and configure a Saturday vaccination clinic at either the East or West outpatient site, with input from pharmacy logistics, nursing education, and facilities.

shared_context.S1: The hospital is considering a Saturday vaccination clinic at either its East or West outpatient site.
shared_context.S2: Each site is normally open from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM on Saturdays.
shared_context.S3: Sixty eligible patients are waiting for appointments in the proposed clinic.
shared_context.S4: Marisol must authorize the site, operating window, and implementation plan.
shared_context.S5: As part of the routine Saturday operations huddle, Marisol checks with pharmacy logistics, nursing education, and facilities before issuing the final authorization.

PF1.text: Pharmacy has 60 doses allocated for Saturday already stored at the West site's monitored refrigerator; only 35 doses are at East, and the validated cold-chain courier needed to move the remaining doses is unavailable on Saturday.

PF2.text: West has two nurses whose vaccination competencies are current, while East has only one currently credentialed nurse; hospital policy requires two credentialed vaccinators for a 60-patient clinic.

PF3.text: Facilities has scheduled generator testing at the West site beginning at 12:30 PM Saturday, so the vaccination room must be cleared by 12:00 PM and facilities must verify the room is empty before testing starts.

acceptance_conditions: The Saturday clinic must be held at the West site because the full 60-dose supply and required staffing are there.
The clinic must start at 9:00 AM.
The clinic must run through 12:00 PM because the West vaccination room must be cleared before generator testing.
All 60 eligible patients must be scheduled.
A commitment must document two credentialed vaccinators for the West clinic.
A commitment must document facilities verification that the vaccination room is clear before generator testing.
The pharmacy supply constraint must be cited as a justification.

content_checks.C5: any('two credentialed vaccinators' in c['detail'] or 'two-vaccinator policy' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('cleared by 12:00 PM' in c['detail'] and 'generator testing' in c['detail'] and '12:30 PM' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The available supply changes the site from either option to West and fixes the schedulable volume at exactly 60 appointments because East has only 35 doses and Saturday transport is unavailable.
The staffing rule changes the site choice to West because West has exactly two credentialed vaccinators while East has only one, and it requires a commitment documenting two credentialed vaccinators.

The generator testing changes the clinic end time from the public 1:00 PM closing to exactly 12:00 PM and requires a commitment stating that the room is cleared by 12:00 PM before generator testing at 12:30 PM.
